# Atomic Fox Media

> Las Vegas production company for commercials, music videos, branded content, short films and TV. Led by producer and First Assistant Director Samson Haveland (25 years, 46 IMDb credits). Silver Telly Award winner.

## About
- Based in Las Vegas, Nevada. Shoots across the Las Vegas Valley, the Strip and the Mojave Desert, and supports productions coming in from out of state.
- Services: commercial production, music videos, branded content, film and TV production, creative development, directing, and Las Vegas production services (crew, locations, permits, equipment).
- Founder: Samson Haveland, producer and First AD. Credits include Edge of Tomorrow, Maleficent, Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix, The Family Plan (Apple TV+) and Unsolved Mysteries (Netflix). IMDb: https://www.imdb.com/name/nm0369732/

## Awards
- Silver Telly Award, Local TV: Promotional, 45th annual Telly Awards, for the Anthem Injury Lawyers '24 spots "Wake" and "Sleep".
- Desert Grave (short film, written and directed by Samson Haveland): Winner, Best Shorts Competition (Award of Merit, Special Mention); semi-finalist at 8 festivals; nominee at 4.
